meta.title: Mazurka: Op.33, No.1
meta.notation_notes: Mutopia MIDI (LilyPond 2.12.2 render, CC BY 3.0, Ryan Prince and the Mutopia Project): one-quarter D#4 pickup at quarter 0, bar 1 at quarter 1, 48 bars of 3/4 to quarter 145 (MIDI tempo 60 BPM). The A reprise (bars 37–48) and the repeat of the dance (29–36) are written out in the MIDI and are not doubled. Mordent (bar 11/47) and grace notes (bars 6, 10, 42, 46) sound as short notes before the beat. Sustain pedal (CC64) only in bars 17–36 and the last bar. MIDI-derived score, not an Urtext.

summary: A short g# minor mazurka in ternary form. A (bars 1–12) is a sighing 12-bar theme over i, ii∅6/5, iv and V7 with two perfect cadences. A borrowed Em/G turns to B major, which is prepared by eight bars of dominant (F# pedal, then V7/V–V) before an 8-bar V7–I dance in B, played twice. D# links back to a literal return of A.

sections.name: A
sections.description: g# minor, 4+4+4: opening phrase with an unaccompanied climb (3–4), then a ii∅6/5–i / iv–i / V7–i phrase stated twice, each ending with a PAC.

sections.name: B (dominant preparation)
sections.description: F# pedal under V7 and a common-tone dim7 (13–16), then V7/V–V four times (17–20): B major is promised but not yet stated.

sections.name: C (B-major dance)
sections.description: ii6–V7–I–V7–I–V7–I in B, 8 bars, repeated literally (29–36); octave-doubled melody from bar 25.

sections.name: A′
sections.description: Literal return of bars 1–12; ends on the second PAC with no coda.

tricks: Bars 0–2: a single upbeat and neighbour-note sigh before any harmony, then viio7/V–V7–i.
Bars 3–4: the accompaniment drops out and the melody climbs alone.
Bars 5–6: accompaniment on beats 2–3 only (iiø6/5–i, iv–i): the mazurka weight sits off the downbeat.
Bar 12: a borrowed Em/G (minor iv of B) as the hinge into the relative major.
Bars 13–20: eight bars of dominant (F# pedal, common-tone dim7, V7/V–V with 4–3 sighs) delay the B tonic until bar 24.
Bars 21–28: two-chord V7–I dance with an added-sixth G#; octave doubling from bar 25 thickens the repeat.
Bar 36→37: D# held from the B chord becomes the upbeat of the returning g# theme.

loop_candidates.why: iiø6/5–i, iv–i, viio7/V–V7, i: ends on the tonic and Chopin himself follows bar 8 with the same phrase (bars 9–12).
B-major dance; the score repeats it literally (29–36), so the seam bar 28→21 is the composer's own.
Octave-doubled V7–I–V7–I; four-bar loop in B.

hook_candidates.why: D# upbeat, E–D# sigh and viio7/V–V7–i: the opening gesture.
V7/V–V swing with high/low register answers.
V7–I with the leaping bass and added-sixth G#.

kpop_uses.why: Bars 5–8 as a minor-key piano bed: four bars, chords on beats 2–3, ending on the tonic (loopable).
Bars 13–20: F# dominant pedal then V7/V–V; builds expectation for a B-major chorus.
Bars 21–28: bright V7–I in B, the relative major of the verse; an 8-bar loop.
Bars 0–4: sparse solo line with almost no harmony for a breakdown before returning to the minor verse.

review_flags.reason: Pickup confirmed from the MIDI (D#4 alone at quarter 0; the viio7/V and V7 fall on beats 2–3 only with a one-quarter offset). The draft had no pickup, so every bar label was one beat early, and its tempo (100) did not match the MIDI (60).
Beat 2 of bars 1/7/11/37/43/47 is read as viio7/V (Cx–E#–G#–B) without E#; left as ? rather than asserting Cx°7 or the draft's misspelled G#dim/D.
Beat 1 of bars 6, 9, 10, 42, 45, 46 has only the melody; the tonic of the previous bar is implied but has stopped sounding, so these spans are ?.

B major is entered at bar 13 for the dominant preparation, but the B tonic first sounds in bar 24. Bars 13–20 could also be read as V of III inside g#; the modulation is confirmed by the 16 bars of B in 21–36.
F#o7 on beat 3 labelled as a common-tone diminished seventh (cto7) over the pedal; spelled F#–A–C–D# as in the MIDI.
C#7 is labelled from beat 1 although the left hand enters on beat 2; the beat-1 F# is read as a prepared 4–3 suspension over C#7 (also in bars 19–20).
Volume swell is taken from MIDI CC7 data, not from pitch changes; other dynamics are not inferred.
